identity.name: Captive Aurora
identity.summary: A green glass prism holding a broad folded violet ribbon.
identity.description: Adds 3 maximum mana, refreshed each round. Supplies 3 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage.
identity.lore: The northern sky lost one color the night it was captured.

effects.description: Adds 3 maximum mana, refreshed each round. Supplies 3 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
